summary: Triton International filed a Form 6-K reporting an amendment and restatement of its credit facility on August 12, 2026. The Thirteenth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement among subsidiaries TCIL and TALICC as borrowers and the company as guarantor extended the maturity date from August 7, 2030 to August 12, 2031, and made definitional and covenant clarifications. No change in ownership, capital structure, or equity value occurred; the filing is a routine financing update. The credit agreement will be filed with the 2026 Form 20-F. This is not a special situation; no strategic or transactional elements are present.
